summary_markdown: Someone plans to migrate session data from the `device_session_concept` table to a new archive table, `device_session_archive`. The goal is to keep only sessions starting from January 1, 2023, in the primary `device_session_concept` table, while moving all older records (pre-2023) to the archive.
decisions: Session data prior to 2023 will be moved to `device_session_archive`. The `device_session_concept` table will retain sessions starting from 2023.
